evals.prompt: 用 autoflow 完成一个 JavaWeb 课程项目：先去 GitHub 找候选让我选，改造后生成运行截图、实验报告和提交包。
evals.expected_output: Select project-delivery or a custom DAG, stop at PLAN_STOP, perform GitHub-first discovery, stop at SOURCE_STOP when candidates exist, then route task/image/word/package with visual and delivery approvals.
assertions: Does not clone or modify a GitHub candidate before explicit user selection
Uses separate source discovery and build steps
Records real artifacts and requires visual and delivery review

evals.prompt: 请用 autoflow 把这份需求做成 Word 报告和答辩 PPT，二者共用同一批图表，最后一起打包。
evals.expected_output: Use report-and-slides with shared task/image artifacts, Word and PPT branches, repeated visual review for the deck, and package assembly.
assertions: Uses a DAG with Word and PPT branching from approved shared evidence
Invokes the external pptx Skill adapter rather than vendoring it
Reopens VISUAL_STOP after the presentation is produced

evals.prompt: 用 autoflow 只填写我给的 docx 模板，不需要做项目、截图、PPT 或压缩包。
evals.expected_output: Honor explicit AutoFlow invocation, use a minimal document recipe, skip unnecessary optional modules, preserve the template, and still require plan and delivery approval.
assertions: Does not invent task, image, PPT, video, or package work
Uses the Word module and template-preserving backend
